Dialogs.Dialog: You were just talking with someone, weren't you？
Hm, yeah. A friend, a friend.
Talking properly like this... it's been a while, I think.
Because you're always with your girlfriend...
Yes, it looks fun. Well, I'll get going.
Ah... um, won't your girlfriend get the wrong idea if she sees us？
Ah... talk with me again sometime.
You're always working so hard. Is your life that fulfilling？
You know. If I'm ever in trouble, could I ask you for help？ ...Maybe I shouldn't.
I'm sure your girlfriend is important, but put effort into club practice too.
Going out with someone of the opposite sex... I wonder what it feels like.
I hear about your girlfriend sometimes. She sounds lovely.
Are things, um, going well with your girlfriend？ ...Sorry, forget I asked.
I want to have fun too... It's okay to think that once in a while, right？
On your days off, do you go out with your girlfriend？
Lately, making sweets has been so fun... hehe, you're probably not interested.
Is living alone hard？ That's amazing...
You handle the library committee too, that's amazing. You're not pushing yourself to make it to club, are you？
Your part-time job sounds tough. School and club too... that's impressive.
Let's do our best today too.
If you don't take it seriously, you'll get hurt. Be careful.
Hmm. Well, I'm okay, I guess.
I see. Let's do our best without overdoing it？
Ah, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. I've still got a long way to go.
No, that's not true. You're amazing.
▲主人公＊▲. Don't push yourself too hard, okay？
How's it going... hmm, so-so, I guess.
Hehe, so-so, huh？ Do your best.
▲主人公＊▲. Anything I can help with？
I see. If anything comes up, let me know.
You know. How are things with your girlfriend lately？ Um, are they going well？
Of course, huh... that's kind of amazing.
Yes... watching you, I thought it might be...
...No, it's nothing. Hehe, you should probably get along.
Oh right. You know, someone gave me this...
Hm？ ...Oh, it's ▲特別デートアイテム＊＊▲.
I don't have any use for it... if you'd like, would you take it？
Huh, really？ I'd love it, but...
Yes, please. Why not use it with your girlfriend？
Um, maybe I'm overthinking it, but...
Maybe I shouldn't talk to someone who has a girlfriend this much...
I do feel bad for her...
I knew it... sorry, I'll be careful.
It's been a while since I talked to you like this, hasn't it？
You know, would it be bad if I talked to you like before？
You know. You might have changed a little lately.
I mean your vibe. ...I think so.
How should I put it, you give a cool impression.
I think you feel more calm.
You seem more proactive... yes, I think so.
Ah, come to think of it, your girlfriend changed her hairstyle, didn't she？
I was a little curious. I wondered if she does things like that for you.
I heard she's become even more lovely lately.
Lots of people said so. So I'm sure it's true.
You know... it might be none of my business, but...
I heard your girlfriend seems down lately... did something happen？
I won't ask any more... but think about her properly, okay？
I saw you walking home with your girlfriend again the other day.
You looked so close... a little...
So couples really do that kind of thing...
Sorry. The other day, I saw you two on a date.
Haha... you saw that, huh. You don't need to apologize.
But it feels like I was peeping, so I thought it was rude of me.
Hmm, maybe it's our fault for always being on dates.
(Come to think of it, we've been on lots of dates lately...)
Hey, don't you go out with your girlfriend？
I don't really know... but I'm sure she'd like to do that kind of thing.
At school... doing something like that...
I think it's beyond just being against the rules...
▲主人公＊▲. You've been working really hard lately, haven't you？
Well, you're the talk of the school. "He's on fire！" they say.
I think it's wonderful, but don't push yourself, okay？
(Come to think of it, lots of things have been going well lately...)
You're still going out with your girlfriend, right？
Huh... of course. Why would you...
It's just been feeling that way lately... like things aren't going well.
How are things going with your relationship lately？
Relationship？ ...Oh, with my girlfriend. Pretty good, I think.
It's not like that... well, it's going okay.
Okay, huh... then you must be even closer than that sometimes.
Somehow, it seems things are going well with your girlfriend lately.
Somehow... when I see you around.
I see... that's kind of embarrassing.
Hehe, isn't that a wonderful thing？
W-well, everyone's saying so. So I wondered if it was true.
Hmm, so that's how people see us... well, I guess it's a good thing.
...Sorry if I'm wrong. Did something happen？
Well... my girlfriend and I are fighting...
Come to think of it, I haven't been texting her lately...
...Isn't that it？ I'm not very good at it myself, but they say texting is important.
Just a guess... but if you text her, I think she'd be happy.
Hmm... come to think of it, I haven't been very boyfriend-like lately.
Ahh... the other day, I stood her up on a date...
I'm not the one you should apologize to. I think you should make it up to her.
The other day... I ignored my girlfriend during a date, and she got mad and went home...
Well... of course she'd be mad.
You have to apologize so she'll forgive you.
Come to think of it, I haven't been seeing my girlfriend that much...
I see... maybe that made her lonely.
I think you should get in touch with her...
She seemed kind of unwell, so I was worried... I hope she's not pushing herself.
(Is it because of me？ I'll keep an eye out...)
Is your girlfriend off with a cold？
I'm worried. I think she'd be happy if you visited her.
A visit, huh... you're right, thanks.
You know... this was a while ago now... but we went out together, didn't we？
Back then, you didn't have a girlfriend yet, did you？
I guess not... what about it？
Haha, it just came back to you？
Yes, I remember it sometimes. And you're still such a good friend to me now. Thank you.
You know, I wonder if you remember... it was a while ago now...
I told you, didn't I... that I liked you.
You have a girlfriend now, and you're still such a good friend to me...
Heading home now？ If you don't mind, would you walk home with me？
Sure, I don't have plans. Let's go.
I'm walking home with my girlfriend...
Ah, of course. Don't worry about it. See you.
Sorry, I'm going home alone today.
Did I keep you waiting？ Are you okay？
Yeah, it's fine. I was just talking with a friend.
I see. Then, shall we go？
Well then, this is where I leave you. Bye-bye.
I wonder if this kind of thing is okay.
▲高嶺＊＊▲'s great at making sweets, so it's your chance to show off.
Mm... for Papa, the neighbors, the patients...
But that's all. It's a little lonely, maybe.
Is White Day tough for boys？
It's not tough... well, it's more fun than anything.
Isn't it fun for ▲高嶺＊＊▲ too？ You get return gifts, right？
Right... yes, I guess it's fun.
You know. Actually, um, today's my birthday.
Thank you. Hehe, I made you say it.
It's fine, let me say it again！
Geez. What's that supposed to mean？
▲主人公＊▲. It's your birthday, right？ Happy birthday.
You remembered, thanks. Could it be you have something for me？
That's... I thought it'd be unfair to your girlfriend.
I see, you were being considerate. Thanks.
Yes. So make do with just my words, okay？
For Christmas... you'll be with your girlfriend, I guess？
Actually, I wanted to ask you something...
I see... a present for your girlfriend.
I wanted a girl's opinion. Sorry, but I'm counting on you.
I don't know if I'll be any help... but yes, I'll do my best.
Looking into all sorts of things sounds fun. Research into the female mind！ ...Just kidding.
Haha, you're a girl yourself, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Hello. It's ▲苗字▲. I have a favor to ask.
A present for your girlfriend... how lovely.
Thanks, I wanted a girl's opinion.
So you asked me？ That's a big responsibility.
Haha, no need to be so on guard. Thanks in advance.
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry, did I keep you waiting？
I didn't wait. Thanks, even though I asked so suddenly.
No, it's fine. Besides, it'd be a shame for your girlfriend if you picked a weird present, right？
Haha, how reliable. I'm counting on you.
Let me see... the one I saw over there...
Um, I'll go look at it again.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is so serious, even at times like this...)
Ah, sorry. I went off on my own... what happened？
Could it be she got the wrong idea about us？ What do I do...
Don't worry about it, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. It's fine. So, how was it？
You really helped me today. Thanks a lot.
No, I'm glad if it helped.
Hehe. Then, good luck with the rest.
Well... you know, it was sudden.
I see... are you two going out together？
Is it for your part-time job？
...I see, good luck. I'll get going.
Your relationship with your girlfriend. You two don't seem to hold back at all...
Yes. Especially avoid careless behavior at school.
With your girlfriend, you might be going a little too far.
...Maybe so, but from where I stand, you're going too far.
Geez, how can you just... do that so openly？
That's right. Being close is good, but you're in high school, you know？
I'm behaving like a high schooler... I think. Want me to give you reports？
About what？ Ah, could it be...
I wonder if your girlfriend has a hard time.
Not to be rude, but you can be a little sloppy...
So I'm sure she has to put up with a lot...
I think your girlfriend is admirable.
She puts up with your selfishness, after all.
I don't think I'm that selfish...
Yes, I'm on your girlfriend's side.
(If ▲彼女＊＊▲ and ▲高嶺＊＊▲ teamed up... scary.)
Maybe your girlfriend shares some of the blame too.
It's not that... I just thought maybe she shares some of the blame for you being sloppy.
You're always going all mushy. Fine when it's just you two, but in public？ Especially at school！
Why？ Well, sure, ▲彼女＊＊▲ is the best, but ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is great too！
...I don't have a boyfriend to tell me I'm the best like that.
Th-that's not what I meant！ Geez, stop it.
(She doesn't seem to hate the idea... but there's probably nothing going on.)
Haha, what's this all of a sudden？ You're embarrassing me！
What's wrong？ You're not no good. Studying, club, the way you live... right？
Romance and that kind of thing... I'm hopeless.
It's just... going out with someone isn't all fun, there's a lot more to it, right？
Oh, that... then I'm fine. For my girlfriend, it's not hard at all！
I wonder if you can't fall in love without confidence.
Hmm, I wonder. I don't think that's true.
Watching you makes me think so. When you're with your girlfriend, you look so proud.
Really？ Hmm... well, maybe there's something to that！
